notes.title: Skyland 1976 - Patch 1.8
notes.content:
[b]New game options, enhanced inventory, improved combat system, balanced enemies stats and more.[/b]

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]

- Improved firearm combat system for player and enemies.
- Improved melee weapons system for enemies.
- Psycho's running speed has been decreased from 490 to 400.
- Chemist's running speed has been decreased from 500 to 400.
- Soldier's running speed has been decreased from 500 to 420.
- Shotgun fire rate has been increased from 0.9s to 1.1s but damage has been increased significantly.
- Headshot damage has been set to 25%.
- Increased damage for shotgun, assault rifle and handgun.
- Improved flashlight detection system.
- Explosive barrels are more dangerous for player and enemies.
- Crouching system has been improved.
- Improved enemies waves system in chapter 15.
- Fixed weapons attachment issue for player character.
- Improved enemies firearm AI.
- Improved AI behavior tree performance.
- Improved collisions system for complex doors and enemies.
- Improved collisions for physics objects such as items.

[h2]Animations[/h2]

- Fixed animation for revolver.
- Fixed Barnett's shotgun animation.
- Updated shotgun location in player camera.
- Improved animations for firearm enemies: Barnett and gas mask soldiers.

[h2]SFX[/h2]

- New footstep sounds for ground, concrete, vent and grass.
- Improved fear sounds for main character.
- Improved alert sound for player detection.
- Fixed enemies end detection sounds.
- Fixed atmosphere music in chapter 5.
- Fixed pick-up sounds for weapons.
- New pump sounds for shotgun.

[h2]VFX[/h2]

- Improved explosion VFX.
- New blood VFX on main character and enemies.
- Fixed impacts VFX on walls and floors.

[h2]UI[/h2]

- Enhanced inventory with new icons and style.
- Smooth UI effects for fear and damage.
- New slider style for UI.
- Improved Skyland operating system UI.
- New quote when player is trying to open inventory before getting backpack.
- New quote when player is trying to use flashlight before getting flashlight.
- New quote in chapter 2, when player is trying to use the vehicule before getting all stuff.
- New quote when player is trying to reload with no ammo left.
- New help messages for scenes with the invincible enemy.
- New help messages explaining how to deal with enemies and vent ducts.
- New game option disabling/enabling flashlight detection.
- New mouse configuration menu.
- Reverse axis mouse option has been added to mouse configuration menu.
- Improved key bindings menu.
- Player can disable player stats in game options such as: sanity, health, battery and strength to play in God mode.
- Key bindings is configured to QWERTY by default and saved to Input.ini. The file ControlSettings.sav is deprecated.
- Shadows quality is set to High instead of Epic by default.

[h2]Localization[/h2]

- Fixed some mistakes in the English and French localization.

[h2]Level design[/h2]

- Collision has been fixed for the key in chapter 8.
- New door style for the kitchen in chapter 8.
- Interaction with gate in chapter 10 has been removed.
- New rope appearance in chapter 11.
- Flashlight intensity has been scaled for each chapter atmosphere.
- Reduced textures size for some assets in chapter 1 & 2.
- Fixed overlapping pipes in chapter 10.
- Increased levers animation speed in both chapter 12 & 13.
- Improved Barnett punch scene.
- Fixed foliage in chapter 5 & 10.
- More foliage and characters in chapter 16.
- Removed custom depth pass on letter in chapter 16.
- Purple color for UV lamps in chapter 12.
- Fixed crates layout at the end of chapters 13 & 14.
- Fixed screws collision in chapter 14.
- Fixed collision for valve outlet in chapter 12.
- Collision for slab has been fixed in chapter 13.
- Collision for trapdoor has been fixed in chapter 11.
- Pyscho automatically stops pursuing player when player reaches the end of a level.
- Doors opening has been speed-up in somes chapters.
- Custom depth pass has been set on backpack in chapter 2.
- Improved hidden spots in chapter 13.
- Improved landscape in chapter 1 & 11.
- One fence door has been removed in chapter 13.
- Fixed save conflict with two complex doors in chapter 12.
- Fixed save conflict with two player volumes in chapter 13.
- Fixed save conflict with two lights in chapter 4.
- Fixed save conflict with two items in chapter 16.
- Lighter is removed from inventory after the chemical puzzle is solved in chapter 10.
- Stamina is set to 100% and stamina update is disabled in chapter 15.
- Last step of the chemical puzzle in chapter 10 has been fixed when loading a game from slot.

[b]If you like the game, don't hesitate to leave me a review, it could help me a lot.[/b]

notes.title: Skyland 1976 - Patch 1.7
notes.content:
[b]New flashlight effect, more items in game, improved UI and more.[/b]

- Psycho's running speed is decreased from 520 to 490.
- Chemical worker's running speed is decreased from 520 to 500.
- Headshot damage is increased from 25% to 30%.
- Max inventory amount of batteries, medkits and pills is increased from 5 to 6.
- Level design is improved in all levels.
- Medkits allow players to regain 35 health points instead of 25.
- Pills allow players to regain 20 sanity points instead of 15.
- A shader issue is fixed in level 2.
- Damage and Sanity HUD is improved.
- More ammo, batteries and medkits is available in game.
- Flashlight is improved with a new ring effect that allows players to better visualise the environment.
- FOV is set to 90° by default. 
- Player's arms are scaled to the new default FOV.
- Player's jump height is decreased from 600 to 450.

[b]If you like the game, don't hesitate to leave me a review, it could help me a lot.[/b]

notes.title: Skyland 1976 - Patch 1.6
notes.content:
- Player can be detected if his flashlight is towards the enemy.
- Revolver reloading time has been decreased from 14s to 9s.
- Headshots increase the amount of damages by 25%.
- Shotgun fire rate has been decreased from 1.2s to 0.9s
- Enemies melee weapon sphere collision radius has been increased from 64 to 256.
- Enemies running speed has been increased from 430 to 520.
- Bullets collision sphere has been increased from 2 to 4.
- Collision capsule of enemies are now more accurate.
- Distance of attacking increased from 250 to 325 for enemies.
- Head bobbing is now set to 0.5 by default.
- Revolver VFX rotation has been fixed.
- Some mistakes have been corrected in the english translation.
- Level design has been improved in multiple chapters.
- More realistics bullets impacts have been added (blood, concrete, metal, wood, etc).
- The radiologic lab key in chapter 13 is no longer attached to the soldier.
- Some sounds issues have been fixed.

With this update I tried to add more dangerous enemies but less difficult to kill with more bullets, balanced weapons and combat system. 

Let me know in comment what you think about this update.

notes.title: Skyland 1976 - Patch 1.5
notes.content:
- You can now change the intensity of the head bobbing in game options.
- You can now change the FOV in video options.

notes.title: Skyland 1976 - Patch 1.4
notes.content:
- I improved the interactive system and removed the game pause state when you start examining something. A timer for the message is used instead.
- I reduced the intensity of the chromatic aberation in game.
- I improved the level design in chapter 2
- I increased the size of a puzzle area in chapter 12.

notes.title: Skyland 1976 - Patch 1.3
notes.content:
- I improved the minefield. It would be easier to cross it now.
- I modified the doors remote control application.
- I fixed some mistakes in the english localization.

notes.title: Skyland 1976 - Patch 1.2
notes.content:
- I increased the size of the puzzle areas. It means that you don't have to be very close of a door to use the key for example.
- I improved the encounter scene with the psycho in chapter 8 and 14. You have to keep hidden until he leaves the room.
- I added more help messages to better understand gameplay mechanisms.
- I simplified a puzzle in chapter 12.

Enjoy !

notes.title: Skyland 1976 - Patch 1.1
notes.content:
This is an update to fix the bolt cutter issue and some minors bugs.

Let me know if you are experiencing others issues :)
